newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BROKERAGE ERROR SEES REX TRUEFORM SKYROCKET.
newsitem.headline: BROKERAGE ERROR SEES REX TRUEFORM SKYROCKET.

text.p: A trading error by a brokerage firm saw shares in Rex Trueform skyrocket to 184.00 rand from 5.30 rand on Monday, lifting the clothing, footwear and textile index nearly 40 percent, dealers said.
Syfrets Securities managing director Richard Pyott confirmed his company had bought the shares at 184 rand, adding it was now investigating adjusting the transaction.
"There is no comment at this stage. The deal is being adjusted," Pyott told Reuters.
Dealers said it appeared as if the brokerage had wanted to buy Investec Bank shares but ended up buying Rex Trueform stocks instead.
"There was an error in coding. It seems they wanted to buy Investec but somehow they bought Rex Trueform," a dealer said.
Rex Trueform jumped to 184 -- the same price as Investec -- although only 100 shares were traded.
The clothing footwear and textiles index leapt to 1,319.1 from 959.0 points on Friday as a result.

Brokerage Consilium Capital, the sellers of the Rex Trueform shares, said a client saw the bid of 184 rand on his screen and asked if there was a buyer at that price. When Consilium confirmed that there was, the client instructed them to sell 1,000 shares at that price but they could only sell 100 shares.
Consilium said the client wanted the deal to stand. The brokerage emphasised that the bid price was left on the screen for some time.
